tools.name: token_risk_demo
tools.description: Free, unlimited sample of the Solana token risk report (for the JUP token) so you can see the output format: 0-100 risk score, verdict, flags (mint/freeze authority, Token-2022 extensions, liquidity, age, holder concentration), market data.

tools.name: token_risk
tools.description: Rug/risk check for any Solana SPL or Token-2022 token mint: mint & freeze authority, dangerous Token-2022 extensions (permanent delegate, transfer hook, transfer fee), DEX liquidity, pair age, holder concentration, Jupiter verification -> 0-100 risk score, verdict (low_risk/caution/high_risk) and fl

tools.name: token_holders
tools.description: Top 20 holders of a Solana token with % of supply, owner wallet and owner type (wallet vs program/LP vault), plus top-10 concentration with and without pool accounts. Use to spot whale/insider concentration. Free tier 20/day per IP.

tools.name: token_prices
tools.description: Live USD prices, 24h change and liquidity for up to 100 Solana token mints in one call. Free tier 20/day per IP.

tools.name: tx_explain
tools.description: Decode any Solana transaction signature: status, fee, action type (swap/transfer), human-readable swap summary, programs used (Jupiter, Raydium, pump.fun, Orca, Meteora...), SOL and token balance changes per owner. Free tier 20/day per IP.

tools.name: pump_new_launches
tools.description: Preview of the 10 newest pump.fun token launches collected live 24/7: mint, name, symbol, creator, dev buy (SOL and % supply), creator launches in last 24h (serial-rugger detection). Paid endpoint returns up to 200 with filters. Free tier 20/day per IP.

tools.name: kol_convergence
tools.description: Solana tokens bought by 2+ distinct tracked KOL / smart-money wallets (public kolscan.io leaderboard wallets) in the last N hours, ranked, with net SOL flow, buyers and current price. Free tier returns top 10; paid endpoint up to 100. Free tier 20/day per IP.

tools.name: kol_trades
tools.description: The 15 most recent swaps by tracked Solana KOL / smart-money wallets: KOL label + X profile, buy/sell, token, SOL size, DEX. Optional filter by token mint. Paid endpoint returns up to 200 with wallet/side filters. Free tier 20/day per IP.

tools.name: kol_token
tools.description: Which tracked Solana KOL wallets traded a token in the last 7 days: per-KOL buys/sells, SOL in/out, net position change (accumulating / exited). Free tier 20/day per IP.

tools.name: paid_endpoints
tools.description: List all Solana Signal API x402 pay-per-call endpoints (USDC on Solana, no API key): token risk, wallet portfolio, token prices, tx explain, wallet activity, pump.fun launches and migrations, KOL trades / convergence / per-token KOL positions, with prices.
